name: Aidan Mack
life: “I still remember arguing about a film during a routine blood test.” On Thursday, near Harbour Bakery, Aidan buys one familiar thing and asks who chose the unfamiliar thing in the window.
voice: I was angry that she was leaving until I realized I'd told her to see her father on every one of my appointments.
appearance: Aidan has two white streaks in otherwise dark hair, a narrow face with an expressive upper lip, and a favorite piece of clothing, a cropped bottle-green coat. It usually goes with a pair of reading glasses in a cloth sleeve. When somebody else has the floor, Aidan turns fully toward the person speaking.
personality: Aidan has a long memory for unfair prices and a short one for small insults. Aidan can get along perfectly well with an enemy provided the account between them is clear.
agenda: To say goodbye without asking for another year's service.
family: Ariel Pierce is Aidan’s younger cousin. Aidan asks the question the rest of the family avoided. Ariel chooses an ordinary story to tell. They tend to get further with an important subject when it arrives in the middle of talk about dinner or work. Asked about *Reopening at six*, Ariel says, “I run a night bus and want to put my clothes in before I go to bed at sunrise.”
connections: Sasha Baldwin. A first orange from the cleaner and a final greeting from an old patient reach the doctor in person.
